dateContracts.title: StrToDate / ScanDate on the dialog date
dateContracts.observed: Order YMD; only ASCII 0x20 is skipped; ScanNumber reads digits while the value is below 1000 (leading zeros allowed; '20091/…' leaves a digit unread and fails at the separator); the separator '/' may be preceded by spaces; once a second '/' is seen the third number is required; one optional trailing '/' and spaces; TryEncodeDate checks Y 1..9999, M 1..12, D 1..month table; TryStrToDate requires Length(S) < Pos (the whole text consumed). A two-number date takes CurrentYear (0x40d4cc) and a year of ≤ 2 digits is widened with the window 0x5ae838.
dateContracts.g1: Typed cells (PHASE0-CALENDAR-TYPED-CELLS.json, G1-VERIFIED.json): era pattern 0x40e724 AnsiString 'e' (sha256 3f79bb7b435b05321651daefd374cdc681dc06faa65e374e38337b88ca046dea) and FarEast pattern 0x40e730 'ddd' (730f75dafd73e047b86acb2dbd74e75dcb93272fa084a9082848f2341aa1abb6) are not substrings of the forced format; month tables 0x5ae83c (1299334ba085db87b1fc794003104052d57a5d9ad6c3d1e49659f9c3916e5e29) and 0x5ae854 (b9ffcb9a732b3f5a516986ce3eaba2a804f063d5cc47aa6d52577b2a4aca3f76) are the Gregorian common/leap tables; IsLeapYear is the Gregorian rule (static instruction reading). Day offset 693594 at 0x40d25e. No native runtime oracle.
dateContracts.modelled: scanDialogDate: exact integer port; outcomes ok, error (syntax, trailing, calendar) or unsupported:host-year (two-number dates and years of ≤ 2 digits, whose result depends on the host year). Refused as a whole; this also covers some forms the native scanner rejects whatever the host year (with two numbers ScanDate 0x40e5c8..0x40e5f3 puts the first in Month, so '2009/06' is always an EConvertError). The host year is never read.

dateContracts.title: Dialog time parser
dateContracts.observed: Tokenizer: delete leading spaces and separator characters, cut at the next separator (or the end), StrToFloat (0x40cf60) the piece, delete it plus one character. Hours by ':', then minutes by ':' if text remains, then seconds by ' ' if text remains; missing parts are 0. ((s/60)+m)/60+h with Single 60 (0x48657c), plus Single 12 (0x48658c) when the remainder equals AnsiString 'PM' (0x486588, content sha256 6b987654a41163849bd70f7354ec7a205cea30d282c0e84be1cfe8a0e3927c78), divided by Single 24 (0x486590). No range check; any other remainder is ignored.
dateContracts.modelled: parseDialogTime: the same tokenization; every part must pass the existing FLOAT_TEXT grammar (parseDelphiFloat) and be a plain signed integer with |part| ≤ 1 000 000; the total is exact integer seconds (WEB-DATE-02). Refusals are browser limits, not recovered native parse errors.

webAdmissions.title: Startup gate (declared adaptation)
webAdmissions.rule: Available iff the exercise is entered, activation has not been reached, a radio UT is applied and the scenario has not stopped at the range end. Activation reached is a sticky latch: antenna activated, or the panel window ever shown (natively showing the form runs FormActivate even when the web refuses activation for an unsupported option profile); it survives RC-11 close and switch Off. Refused gates show a disabled item with the reason.
webAdmissions.basis: The browser has no Run step; the workbench already admits radio access after exercise selection (RC-02 → RC-03) from bundled assets instead of the CD-ROM/catalog path. That check concerns star-catalog files, not date or ID input.
webAdmissions.notClaimed: Run executed; Windows file availability; effects of the Run callees 0x589bd8 and 0x58edcc; a value for item454Enabled; native startup, modal or GDI timing.

webAdmissions.title: Text and number subset
webAdmissions.rule: Printable ASCII (0x20..0x7e) only; date and time ≤ 32 characters, ID ≤ 18 (DFM MaxLength); edits outside are refused at the field (no silent truncation). Date: exact RC-15 port. Time: FLOAT_TEXT tokens, plain signed integers, |part| ≤ 1 000 000, else unsupported (spelling, form, large). The result must lie in 1900-01-01T00:00:00Z … 2099-12-31T23:59:59Z, else unsupported:domain (for example year 0009 is natively valid but outside the browser range).
webAdmissions.notClaimed: x87 Extended/double evaluation, the cancellation of the Extended at 0x5bc221 (record 0x5bc1f7 + 0x2a; its time-zone role is inferred from analyst notes on 0x487b64, not established), DecimalSeparator-dependent forms, any error bound against the native result.

webAdmissions.title: Clock application
webAdmissions.rule: applyRadioClockDialogUT: utc and draftUTC := the ISO text, elapsedMS := 0, run + 1, limit := null; Start/Pause intent kept; a running anchored scenario re-anchors at the performance time, a frozen one stays unanchored; longitude untouched. No Now₁/Now₂ delta or env+0x382b offset.

webAdmissions.title: Presentation and ID scope
webAdmissions.rule: The ID lives only in the route state for this window: never saved, exported, imported from a DAT file or written into records, and nothing reads it. Error-box wording is OpenVireo's. Tab order follows the visual layout (ID first; native TabOrder Date, Time, OK, Cancel, ID); no system-menu close. The route reports the panel's presentation gated by its own active/busy inputs (the panel's report arrives one commit late), so hiding the route or starting a project operation releases the App in the same commit. When the dialog closes, focus returns to the menu item, or to the Radio UT field when the item is no longer available (the range-end gate closed while open); a suppression, a hidden or busy route or a native modal moves no focus. In the App every route change cancels a running project operation and the route is inert while one runs, so busy suppression has no normal App path; it is defensive and was checked only with a controlled route host, not by tests/radio-date-app.spec.ts.
webAdmissions.notClaimed: Historical ID metadata or persistence; native error text.
